Invoker of Bhaal Ellice is a human member of the Cult of Bhaal in the Undercity Ruins within the Undercity of

Involvement

As part of the 'test' to enter the Bhaal Temple, the  Farslayer of Bhaal Ghislev surprises the party with a combat encounter. He begins casting a ritual spell to kill the party after a certain number of turns, and his minions (including Zeironymous) appear and attack the party as they attempt to cross the bridge to stop Ghislev.
